description: Depuradoras is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. Estaciones depuradoras ubicadas en la provincia de Castellón, con indicación de la titularidad, fórmula de gestión, tratamiento y capacidad. Las diferentes estaciones depuradoras están geolocalizadas. El dataset incorpora un archivo adjunto sobre el manual de instrucciones que nos ayuda a entender la nomenclatura que aparece en las columnas. Coverage: Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. The publisher named on the listing is Diputación Provincial de Castelló/Castellón. Its keywords include provincia de Castellón, geolocalizado, residuos, municipios, calidad ambiental. The listing shows 5 download or service links in JSON, CSV, ZIP. The listing shows 2023-01-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
